# Maru

> Maru is a small iPhone app for daily vitamins, supplements, and simple medication schedules. It reminds you at the times you choose, shows what to take now, and keeps a record. It is not on the App Store yet.

Facts:
- Free, with no subscription, no ads, no account, and no limit on items. Optional tips unlock nothing.
- Items and records stay on the iPhone. Optional usage statistics never include names, doses, or times.
- Today screen: record a dose with one tap.
- Local reminders at the times you choose, with an optional "Remind Again" of up to 12 more reminders for a dose.
- History with undo and correction. Record export, backup, and restore.
- Home Screen widgets.
- Languages: English, Simplified Chinese, Japanese, Spanish, German, and Korean.
- Maru does not track stock, give medical advice, or pick a dose or a time for you.
- Maru has no Apple Watch app and no sync between devices.

Pages:
- [FAQ](https://maru.day/faq.html): short answers.
- [Privacy](https://maru.day/privacy.html): what the app stores and what it does not do.
- [Support](https://maru.day/support.html): hello@maru.day and the feedback form.
- [Source](https://github.com/ImHangLi/maru): MIT license.
